description: This file defines event argument classes, delegates, and a container class for handling text rendering events in the PDFsharp library, including preparing text, rendering text, and managing glyph indices during PDF text rendering.

classes.name: PrepareTextEventArgs
classes.description: Event arguments for preparing text before drawing or measuring, including font and text properties.

classes.name: RenderTextEventArgs
classes.description: Event arguments for rendering text, including glyph index pairs and glyph reevaluation flag.

classes.name: RenderEvents
classes.description: A class encapsulating all rendering-related events for a PDF document, including methods to invoke event handlers.

methods.name: OnPrepareTextEvent
methods.description: Invokes the PrepareTextEvent delegate when text is about to be drawn or measured.

methods.name: OnRenderTextEvent
methods.description: Invokes the RenderTextEvent delegate when text is drawn or measured.
